import struct, sys

LBA = 2048
path = '/app/alpine.iso'
f = open(path,'rb')

def read_lba(lba, size):
    f.seek(lba*LBA)
    return f.read(size)

pvd = read_lba(16, LBA)
volid = pvd[0x40:0x60].rstrip(b'\x00').rstrip(b' ').decode('ascii', 'replace')
print("VOLUME LABEL:", repr(volid))
rec = pvd[156:156+34]
root_lba = struct.unpack('<I', rec[2:6])[0]
root_size = struct.unpack('<I', rec[6:10])[0]
print("ROOT LBA:", root_lba, "size:", root_size)

def parse_dir(lba, size, depth=0):
    data = read_lba(lba, size)
    off = 0
    entries = []
    while off < len(data):
        rlen = data[off]
        if rlen == 0: break
        name_len = data[off+54]
        raw = data[off+55:off+55+name_len]
        lba2 = struct.unpack('<I', data[off+2:off+6])[0]
        size2 = struct.unpack('<I', data[off+6:off+10])[0]
        flags = data[off+38]
        is_dir = (flags % 4) >= 2
        name = raw.decode('ascii','replace')
        if name not in ('\x00','\x01'):
            print('  '*depth + ('[D] ' if is_dir else '     ') + name + '  lba=%d size=%d' % (lba2, size2))
            entries.append((name, lba2, size2, is_dir))
        off += rlen
    return entries

f=open('/app/alpine.iso','rb')
def rl(lba,n):
    f.seek(lba*2048); return f.read(n)

print("MBR sig:",mbr[-2:].hex(),"(55aa expected)")
print("MBR bootcode head:",mbr[:16].hex())
# Partition table
for i in range(4):
    p=mbr[446+i*16:446+(i+1)*16]
    if p[0]!=0:
        print("  part%d type=%02x start_lba=%d size=%d"%(i,p[4],struct.unpack('<I',p[8:12])[0],struct.unpack('<I',p[12:16])[0]))
# scan for volume descriptors in LBAs 15..40
for lba in range(15,41):
    d=rl(lba,2048)
    t=d[0]
    if t in (0,1,2,255):
        extra=""
        if t==2:
            # El Torito supplemental boot record: boot catalog ptr at 0x47
            bc=struct.unpack('<I',d[0x47:0x4b])[0]
            extra="ET catalog LBA=%d"%bc
        print("LBA %3d: type=%d %s"%(lba,t,extra))
